ConsumerSecret.description: Twitter/X API consumer secret. The step stores the value as given, and Orchard Core decrypts it with the tenant's Data Protection keys, so a clear value does not work. Prefer a secret: create it with the 'Secrets' step and reference it with 'ConsumerSecretSecretName' in the 'TwitterSettings' property of the 'Settings' step.

AccessToken.description: Twitter/X API access token used for authenticated requests.

AccessTokenSecret.description: Twitter/X API access token secret. The step stores the value as given, and Orchard Core decrypts it with the tenant's Data Protection keys, so a clear value does not work. Prefer a secret: create it with the 'Secrets' step and reference it with 'AccessTokenSecretSecretName' in the 'TwitterSettings' property of the 'Settings' step.
